meta.name: agentmail
meta.description: API-first email platform designed for AI agents. Create and manage dedicated email inboxes, send and receive emails programmatically, and handle email-based workflows with webhooks and real-time events. Use when you need to set up agent email identity, send emails from agents, handle incoming email workflows, or replace traditional email providers like Gmail with agent-friendly infrastructure.

copy.tagline: 为AI代理创建和管理专用邮箱，收发邮件并处理工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为AI代理搭建独立邮箱系统并自动化邮件处理
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up dedicated email inboxes for AI agents and automate email workflows

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以创建和管理专属邮箱，通过 API 发送和接收邮件，并利用 webhook 实时处理收到的邮件。
howto.when: 当你需要让 Claude 拥有自己的邮箱地址、发送邮件、或自动处理收到的邮件时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个邮箱地址，用户名叫 spike-assistant。
设置一个 webhook，当收到新邮件时通知我。
say.note: 会注册一个 webhook 端点用于实时接收邮件事件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create and manage dedicated email inboxes, send and receive emails via API, and handle incoming emails with webhooks in real time.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to have its own email address, send emails, or automatically process incoming emails.

say_en.text: Create an inbox with username spike-assistant.
Send an email to adam@example.com with subject 'Task completed' and body saying PDF is done.
Set up a webhook to notify me when new emails arrive.
say_en.note: Registers a webhook endpoint for real-time email events.
